posts.cooked:
We all knew this discussion was coming. I've been waiting for a while for us to be able to talk about this. But now it's time. Maybe it's a little early? Not necessarily for us playtesters. But I didn't want to cut everyone else out of the discussion. I'm sure we've all got our own thoughts, regardless of what you may know, and what you may not know that you do not know, etc.

The fight of the century: the Freedom Five goes head to head with the Prime Wardens in the fight that will have every reader of Sentinel Comics glued to the pages. It is bound to happen. In a great big multiverse, there's a timeline somewhere in which these two teams lay a heavy smack-down on one another. We'll eventually be able to act out this fight in Sentinel Tactics, but for now...

Who comes out on top?

posts.name: EvanDan55
posts.cooked:
I'm putting metaphorical money on Team Freedom. I think they'd win because of how well they work together. They've spent years at each others' sides, getting to know what works best with their team. Sure, Prime Wardens work well together as a team, but I can't see them having the finely-tuned coordination that the Freedom Five have spent years mastering. The Freedom team has spent nearly their entire career together--they've always fought together, whereas Wardens (I assume) have been fighting solo for a while, or at least not with their team.

So it's the years of perfected teamwork that give the Freedom Five the victory to me.
